mapper.insert: INSERT INTO form_field (section_id, subsection_id, field_key, label, description, type, options, dict_key, dict_version, required, show_when, sort_order, config) VALUES (#{sectionId}, #{subsectionId}, #{fieldKey}, #{label}, #{description}, #{type}, #{options}, #{dictKey}, #{dictVersion}, #{required}, #{showWhen}, #{sortOrder}, #{config})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM form_field WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE form_field SET dict_version = #{dictVersion} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM form_field f LEFT JOIN form_section s ON f.section_id = s.id LEFT JOIN form_subsection ss ON f.subsection_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN form_section s2 ON ss.section_id = s2.id JOIN form_template t ON t.id = COALESCE(s.template_id, s2.template_id) WHERE f.field_key = #{fieldCode} AND t.kind = 'ATOM'

SELECT t.id AS templateId, t.form_key AS formKey, t.name AS templateName, t.version AS templateVersion, t.kind AS kind, f.id AS fieldId, f.field_key AS fieldKey, f.label AS fieldLabel FROM form_field f LEFT JOIN form_section s ON f.section_id = s.id LEFT JOIN form_subsection ss ON f.subsection_id = ss.id LEFT JOIN form_section s2 ON ss.section_id = s2.id JOIN form_template t ON t.id = COALESCE(s.template_id, s2.template_id) WHERE f.field_key = #{fieldCode} AND t.kind = 'ATOM' ORDER BY t.form_key ASC, t.version DESC
